description: This file is a shell script used to manage the startup, shutdown, and reinitialization of the UPnP Internet Gateway Device (IGD) daemon, including handling network events and process management.

methods.name: resync_upnp
methods.description: Handles the synchronization of UPNP configurations across network interfaces, including starting or stopping IGD processes as needed.

methods.name: check_IGD_is_up
methods.description: Checks if the IGD process is running, starts it if not, retrying up to 12 times with 5 second sleeps.

methods.name: handle_ipv4_status
methods.description: Manages the IGD process based on IPv4 network status, starting or killing the process as required.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the IGD service, initializing necessary files and states, and invoking resync.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the IGD service, kills the IGD process, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: init_once
methods.description: Performs one-time initialization, creating necessary directories and symbolic links.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Fetches configuration and calls init_once to set up the environment.
